# Polder OS internationalisation (nl + en)

gettext domain `polder`, English msgids, `po/nl.po` holds the Dutch UI text.

* Python: `from polder_i18n import _, ngettext` (config/osb/polder_i18n.py)
* Rust: `shell/polder-shelf/src/i18n.rs` (small .mo loader: `tr`, `trn`, `tf!`, `n_`)
* .desktop / polkit: English base, `[nl]` / `xml:lang="nl"` generated by `tools/i18n/desktop.py`

Language: `$POLDER_LANG` > `~/.config/polder/language` > LANGUAGE/LC_ALL/LC_MESSAGES/LANG
(`en*` = English, else Dutch). Chosen in Instellingen > Taal en regio or welcome step 1;
writes `~/.config/environment.d/50-polder-language.conf`, restarts shell components live;
"Voor het hele systeem" runs localectl. Live ISO has a "Polder OS Live (English)" boot entry.

Workflow:

    python3 tools/i18n/extract.py && python3 tools/i18n/update.py
    # edit po/nl.po
    python3 tools/i18n/desktop.py && python3 tools/i18n/compile.py && python3 tools/i18n/check.py

Known gaps: assistant LLM system prompt stays Dutch; systemd unit Descriptions not localized;
existing snapshot descriptions on disk stay in the language they were made in; GTK stock strings
need generated locales; .mo only shipped via the ISO (no deb packaging yet).
